subject: Admin activity export: per-service retention carve-outs & proof package
messages:
From: Lydia Park <audit@brightwater.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: MedicoSys Compliance <compliance@medicosys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin-activity evidence for MedicoSys SOC 2 scope

Hi Camila,

Brightwater is scoping the admin-activity evidence for MedicoSys's upcoming SOC 2 Type II. For the sections that map to CC6 (system activities) and CC7 (change management), we need a signed export showing what admin/operator events are retained and how they are delivered. Specifically, please confirm the following for the last 12 months: 

- Canonical event types you capture (e.g., operator_action, config_change, role_assignment, key_rotation, session_grant).
- Per-service retention windows and any carve-outs (e.g., auth events vs. config snapshots).
- Export formats you can produce (CSV/NDJSON/parquet), and whether timestamps are UTC and timezone-normalized.
- Redaction strategy for PII and whether you can produce a sample data bundle with redaction markers.
- Manifest/attestation options: HMAC-signed manifests, checksums, or notarized delivery options.
- Typical turnaround for a full-year bundle vs. a sampled bundle.

Also advise if you can provide an attested manifest (human-signed cover letter acceptable) and whether exports will include per-record session IDs and operator identifiers or only hashed identifiers. Our requested delivery date for a test bundle is 2026-11-17 so we can validate formatting.

Can you confirm scope and delivery ETA? If there are any constraints (retention shorter than 12 months or legal hold issues), note them up front.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Senior Auditor, Brightwater Security

---
Brightwater Security, audit@brightwater.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <audit@brightwater.com>
Cc: MedicoSys Compliance <compliance@medicosys.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:08:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin-activity evidence for MedicoSys SOC 2 scope

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear scope. Glad to help. Below is what Redwood can provide and a quick ask to confirm a few minor scope items.

What we capture (per-service, operator-level):
- event_type: operator_action | config_change | role_assignment | key_rotation | api_key_issue | session_grant | privilege_escalation
- actor_identity: user_id (internal), service_account_id (internal), external_identity (hashed)
- target: resource_id, model_id, pool_id, route_id
- metadata: ip_address (optional redaction), user_agent, request_id, session_id, request_body_hash

Retention and carve-outs:
- Default admin activity retention: 13 months (rolling).
- Ephemeral operator traces (high-volume runtime telemetry) are kept 30 days by default; we can include these in a one-off export if requested but they are not in the standard 13-month bundle.
- Key material rotation audit logs are retained 24 months for system integrity events.

Export options and format:
- Formats: gzipped NDJSON (recommended), CSV (flat), or parquet (optimized).
- Timestamps: always UTC in ISO8601; we include local_zone metadata when available.
- Manifests: HMAC-SHA256 manifest + SHA256 checksums per file; we can also provide a short signed attestation (PDF) from Redwood Security.

PII and redaction:
- We can provide full records with PII redacted (IP address redaction modes: none/truncate/hash).
- We will include explicit redaction markers and an example sample (not containing customer PII) if you want to validate formatting.

Turnaround and sampling:
- Full 12-month bundle (13 months retention window) for account-level extraction: ~5 business days once we have the exact account IDs and timebox.
- Sample bundle (10k records stratified by event_type): 1 business day.

Questions for you:
1) Do you require un-hashed operator identifiers or will hashed IDs suffice for linkage?
2) Confirm whether you need ephemeral runtime traces included (30-day data) vs. only 13-month admin events.

Planned deliverables (if you confirm scope):
- admin_activity_manifest.csv (file list + checksums + per-file record counts)
- export-manifest-checksum.txt (SHA256 over manifest)
- readme-export-spec.md (field defs, redaction notes, sampling summary)

If those look good, we will coordinate a secure transfer (S3 presigned URL with IP-restricted download or a secure GDrive link) and include an HMAC-signed manifest and a short attestation PDF.

Camila Reyes
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

On a related note, copying Kim and Karthik to coordinate the export.
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:43:05 -0800
Subject: Internal: Admin activity export for MedicoSys — action items

Team — quick internal plan for MedicoSys / Brightwater request (delivery target: 2026-11-17 for a test bundle):

- Kimberly: produce HMAC-SHA256 manifest + human-readable readme. Include per-file record counts and the key used to compute HMAC (we will exchange key out-of-band). Deadline: 2026-11-15 EOD.
- Karthik: run the admin_activity extractor scoped to MedicoSys account IDs (please confirm account list with Camila). Redact IPs by default (we'll follow auditor preference if they ask for hashes instead). Produce gzipped NDJSON + parquet variant. Deadline: 2026-11-16 noon.
- Jordan: prepare the S3 presigned transfer bucket with IP restrictions and object lifecycle (auto-delete after 30 days). Also compute SHA256 per-file and place checksum in export-manifest-checksum.txt. Deadline: 2026-11-16 EOD.

Notes:
- We will include a short attestation PDF signed by Security that the export was produced under Redwood runbook R-INF-AUD-03.
- Sampling option: provide a 10k-record stratified sample within 1 business day (Kim to create sample script).

Ack by reply and I'll follow up with the account IDs (MedicoSys provided an initial list in their intake).

Camila

---
Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:12 -0800
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Ack — will prepare manifest and README. Will include checksums and HMAC instructions.
From: Lydia Park <audit@brightwater.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: MedicoSys Compliance <compliance@medicosys.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Admin activity export: per-service retention carve-outs & proof package

Camila — this looks good, thanks. MedicoSys confirms hashed operator IDs are acceptable for our linkage tests. They do want ephemeral runtime traces excluded from the standard bundle (we will request those separately if needed).

Please deliver the test bundle to the S3 presigned URL and include the following: admin_activity_manifest.csv, export-manifest-checksum.txt, readme-export-spec.md, and the short attestation PDF. Include the manifest signature method in the README and confirm the HMAC key exchange mechanism (we prefer a separate secure key share via your KMS-managed wrapping).

If you can hit the 2026-11-17 window for the test bundle, we will validate and come back with any format comments by 2026-11-20. If not, advise an updated ETA.

Thanks — Lydia (on behalf of MedicoSys compliance)

---
Attachments referenced: admin_activity_manifest.csv (list of files + checksums), readme-export-spec.md (field definitions, redaction notes), export-manifest-checksum.txt (SHA256)
